address: Courte Rue du Rivage 1, Wavre, 1300, Belgium
bio: Quirkily tucked away behind shops, this Altro Mondo acquaints you with the highly personal vision of Luca and Caroline. Italian influences dominate the menu, such as Tagliani in truffles in a powerful gutsy sauce. You can also expect a line-up of more modern dishes that reflect the character of the enthusiastic, charismatic sommelier....
